name: Atorvastatin + Ezetimibe
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.indication: Hypercholesterolemia or mixed dyslipidemia; prevention of cardiovascular events
usual_adult_dose.dose: 10/10 mg to 10/80 mg once daily; titrate at intervals of 4 weeks or more; 2 hours before or 4 hours after a bile acid sequestrant

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated; restart statin 7 days after the last fusidic acid dose.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole), tipranavir/ritonavir
key_interactions.action: Avoid; if unavoidable use lower doses (tipranavir/ritonavir: maximum 10/10 mg).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors (erythromycin, diltiazem, verapamil, fluconazole)

key_interactions.action: Use with caution; monitor cyclosporine levels.

serious: Anaphylaxis; Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis

contraindications: Active liver disease or unexplained transaminases above 3 times the upper limit
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, women of childbearing potential without contraception
monitoring: Liver tests before starting and periodically
Lipids at 4 weeks or more after a dose change

pk.half_life: Ezetimibe about 22 hours; atorvastatin about 14 hours (inhibitory activity 20 to 30 hours)
pk.half_life_eskd: Atorvastatin unaffected; ezetimibe AUC about 1.5-fold at CrCl ≤30
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Ezetimibe 11% in urine (78% feces); atorvastatin mainly biliary
